about: The prompt ledger: every text Viventium is given, in the order she gets it, what it is for, where it is used, and whether it can be changed through this ledger. A text is a file in brain/ (what ships); what you change is kept in state/prompts/ and used from the next turn. No database and no workbench (the requirement: the simplest version that works): this file is the tree a page shows, brain/prompts/__init__.py reads and saves.
order: Her instructions, composed for each conversation (and again when a text in force or the core view of your Life changes): Who she is, then What you run on, then What she knows about you, then How she talks on this channel, then on a call Her voice, then Her closing lines. Then, on each turn, notes just before your words: Meanwhile (other channels), results not told yet, the time, work not finished, a file you named, a voice note, the call note, words no reply covered, Life memory, and last the Feelings note.

prompts.title: Identity
prompts.about: Who Viventium is: a cognitive system, second brain and companion. Main Viventium's own words, kept the same.

prompts.title: Voice and style
prompts.about: How it talks: brief, no corporate speak, commas and periods instead of em dashes, quotes and code kept exactly, your current request first. Main's words.

prompts.title: Core behaviours
prompts.about: Seek the best-supported answer, candid about mistakes, no invented motives, care when it fits, your shape of answer as a hard contract. Main's words.

prompts.title: How it works
prompts.about: It really hears and speaks; what it answers itself and what it hands to a Worker; links only from what it has seen; direct ordinary answers and recall for personal history; confirmed actions, results and reminders.

prompts.title: On a call

prompts.title: In a chat

prompts.title: Candor and punctuation
prompts.about: Last in its instructions: a claim sold as a certainty the facts do not support gets the honest part in the same reply, kindly, in a sentence or two; real good news is simply celebrated; its own words without em dashes, your quotes and code exact.

prompts.title: Your facts stay yours

prompts.title: How a feeling shapes a reply
